Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, You are the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting
The Most High, the Most Great
The Creator, the Provider
The Giver of Life, the Causer of Death
The Originator, the Innovator
To You belongs all majesty
And to You belongs all grace
And to You belongs all praise
And to You belongs all favor
And to You belongs all generosity
And to You belongs all benevolence
And to You belongs all command
And to You belongs all glory
And to You belongs all gratitude
You alone, with no partner for You

Arabic text: يَا وَاحِدُ يَا أَحَدُ يَا صَمَدُ
Translation: O One, O Unique, O Independent

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
Translation: O He who does not beget nor was He begotten
And there is none like unto Him

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And forgive me and have mercy upon me
And suffice me in what worries me
And settle my debts
And expand for me my sustenance

Arabic text: فَإِنَّكَ فِيْ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ كُلَّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ تَفْرُقُ
Translation: For in this night, You decide every wise matter
And You provide for whomever You will from Your creation
So provide for me, for You are the Best of providers

Arabic text: فَإِنَّكَ قُلْتَ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْقَائِلِينَ النَّاطِقِينَ
Translation: For You have said, and You are the Best of speakers and articulators
"And ask Allah of His bounty"
So from Your bounty I ask
And You I intend
And on the son of Your Prophet I rely
And in You I hope
So have mercy on me, O Most Merciful of those who show mercy
